Amir International Charity Organization

About Us

Welcome to Amir International Charity Organization, dedicated to making a positive difference in those in need. We are a team of compassionate and driven individuals, working tirelessly to provide essential resources and support to those in need throughout the world. While our program is currently limited to the East African region of Ethiopia, we are planning to expand our services in the near future.

Learn More

Our Programs

Nutritional support

This program provides access to nutritious food, essential groceries, and meals to those who may not have the means.

Donate Now

Education Assistance

provides resources and support to individuals and communities who may not have access to quality education and aims to break down barriers to provide equal opportunities. This provide access to textbooks, school supplies, and tuition fees for those who cannot afford them.

Donate Now

Medical

This program is vital for those who do not have access to proper medical care due to financial constraints, Your support for this program can help ensure that everyone has the opportunity to receive the medical care they need.

Donate Now

Orphans and children care

This program provides basic necessitates to vulnerable children, such as shelter, food, clothing, and healthcare. It can also provide educational opportunities, mentorship programs, and other activities to foster growth and development.

Donate Now

Single Mothers

Single mothers aid is geared towards empowering single mothers to become self- sufficient and create a better living condition for themselves and their children.

Donate Now

General aid

General care is a program that caters to the needs of vulnerable individuals and communities who are facing various challenges. This includes medical assistance, housing, emergency shelter, disaster relief, and nutritional support.

Donate Now

Mission

The mission of our organization is to improve the health and well-being of individuals and communities. Scarcity of resources, unforgiving political conflicts, and other factors can negatively impact individuals in the region. That’s why we believe it’s critical, now more than ever, to give back to the community and support those who need it most.

Learn More
Donate Now

Core Value

At our core, we believe in the power of compassion and strive to create sustainable change that will positively impact individuals and communities well into the future. Our efforts are focused on providing access to clean water, nutritious food, education, and healthcare services to individuals and communities throughout Ethiopia.

Volunteer with Us

Join Us To
Make Impact

At Amir International Charity Organization, volunteers are the heartbeat of our mission. By joining our team, you become an integral part of our efforts to uplift communities and create lasting change. Whether you’re helping to distribute resources, offering your expertise, or simply lending a helping hand, your contribution makes a world of difference. We invite you to be a part of our growing movement, as we work together to bring hope and support to those who need it most.
